intro.text: Northbridge Cyber Games. Quick party games about staying safe online. Pick a game, watch the 30-second tutorial, then play together on one screen while Shield, your scripted sidekick, steps in before a mistake. Tap a card to hear what it is.

card-inbox-showdown.text: Inbox Showdown. Open the safe messages, report the scams. Teams triage a shared Northbridge inbox; Shield warns before a risky click. For 2 to 6 players, about 3 minutes.

card-first-week-hunt.text: First Week Hunt. Tap the 8 hidden risks before time runs out. Hot-seat scavenger hunt for 8 hidden risks in the Northbridge office; two wrong taps and you get hacked. For 2 to 6 players, about 3 minutes.

card-phish-or-fine.text: Phish or Fine? Buzzer Battle. Buzz first: is it a phish or fine? Split-screen buzzer race: call each snippet phish or fine; Shield debriefs every player. For 2 to 6 players, about 3 minutes.
